panels.label: A failed test

panels.note: buying is starting | to appear

panels.label: Closes on the HIGH

panels.label: Selling has dried up
panels.note: less and less selling on the way down | → the market wants to go UP

panels.label: Buying has dried up
panels.note: less and less buying on the way up | → the market wants to FALL

panels.note: all you can see is a wide spread | closing near the high

panels.label: The same day, intraday
panels.note: the heavy volume came in at the low | — that was buying

panels.label: Higher lows
panels.note: each low is higher | than the last one

panels.label: Lower highs
panels.note: each high is lower | than the last one

weakness-signatures.title: The four main signs of weakness

panels.label: Buying climax
panels.note: wide spread up, huge | volume, at the top

panels.label: Up-thrust
panels.note: pokes up, then closes | near its low

panels.label: No demand
panels.note: narrow up-bar, | low volume

panels.label: Narrow spread, high volume
panels.note: into new highs, | no progress made

relative-strength.title: Picking a stock: compare it with its index

panels.label: The index falls
panels.note: the whole market | is going down

panels.label: Your stock refuses to fall
panels.note: someone is supporting it | — that is accumulation

resistance.title: Why rallies stall in the same place

zones.label: buyers trapped at the old top

resistance.note: Every rally stalls in the same band. | Those trapped buyers are selling just to get their money back.

supply-area.title: Pushing up through an area of supply
supply-area.note: The high volume is professional money absorbing the trapped sellers. | Price keeps going afterwards, so the supply has been beaten.

high-volume-top.title: High volume at a market top
high-volume-top.note: If that volume were really buying, the spread would be wide | and the price would have travelled. It did not.

channel.title: Overbought and oversold are relative to the channel
channel.note: Near the top of the channel the market is overbought. | Near the bottom it is oversold. Both are relative, never absolute.

absorption.title: Absorption volume at a lower trend line

marks.text: but the next bar is UP

absorption.note: If that volume had really been selling, the market could not have risen. | It contained buying.

upthrust.title: An up-thrust, bar by bar
upthrust.note: Pushed above the recent highs to trigger stops and pull buyers in, | then closed near its own low on high volume.

selling-climax.title: A selling climax
selling-climax.note: Ultra-wide spread down on exceptional volume — but it closes near the HIGH. | The panic is what lets professional money buy heavily.

buying-climax.title: A buying climax
buying-climax.note: The heaviest volume of the entire move arrives on UP-bars at the top. | That is professional selling into an eager public.

shakeout.title: A shake-out
shakeout.note: The last weak holders are frightened out, then the market gaps back up. | Only bullish when there is no distribution behind it.

stopping-volume.title: Stopping volume
stopping-volume.note: A down-bar on very high volume that closes on its high — | buy orders large enough to act as a brake on the fall.

falling-pressure.title: Falling pressure
falling-pressure.note: Prices are falling, but nobody is really selling. | Not a buy signal — it only says the fall is unlikely to go much further.

buying-and-selling.title: Healthy buying, and buying with supply hidden in it

panels.label: Healthy buying
panels.note: up-bars, volume increasing | but not excessive

panels.label: Too much volume on an up-bar
panels.note: excessive volume means supply | is meeting the buying

mark-up.title: Why big moves happen so fast

marks.text: marked up in a single bar

mark-up.note: The speed is deliberate. It locks you out of a good trade, or into a bad one, | before you have time to react.

trend-lines.title: Drawing the two trend lines
trend-lines.note: One line along the highs, one along the lows. | Old lines from far back in the chart still act as support and resistance.

trend-scaling.title: The same market at two zoom levels

panels.label: Zoomed out
panels.note: one smooth-looking trend

panels.label: Zoomed in
panels.note: the same move is jagged | at a smaller scale

trend-clusters.title: How a trend cluster forms
trend-clusters.note: Where several old trend lines happen to intersect, price tends to react. | Only lines starting before the current view are used.

using-clusters.title: Reading trend clusters correctly

marks.text: do not extend it past here

using-clusters.note: Beyond the end of the cluster the trends are diverging, so it means nothing. | A cluster only matters when price is actually close to it.

volume-near-line.title: Where effort shows up near a trend line
volume-near-line.note: Changing a trend costs money. You see that effort as price approaches the line, | not once it is sitting on it.

breakout-test.title: Breaking through the top of a channel

marks.text: wide spread, high volume, through the line

breakout-test.note: The push through must be on high volume, and the next bar must hold. | A low-volume down-bar afterwards is the confirmation.

bull-start.title: How a bull market begins
bull-start.note: Bull markets start in gloom. Once the stock has passed to strong hands, | the market can rise on very little buying.

market-top.title: Recognising a likely market top

marks.text: new high ground, narrow spread, huge volume

market-top.note: Into new high ground there is nothing to the left on the chart. | If that volume were buying, the spread would be wide.

end-of-rally.title: The five signs that stop an up-move

panels.label: Buying climax
panels.note: huge volume | on an up-bar

panels.label: Failed test
panels.note: test shape, but | volume is high

panels.label: Narrow spread, high volume
panels.note: no progress | on big effort

panels.label: Up-thrust
panels.note: closes near | its own low

panels.label: No demand
panels.note: narrow up-bar, | low volume

stock-climax.title: A buying climax in a single stock

marks.text: wide spread up, huge volume, no response

stock-climax.note: The rapid mark-up and the good news cloud your judgement. | That is exactly what it is designed to do.

bear-rally.title: Rallies inside a bear market
bear-rally.note: In a bear market any low-volume up-move is weakness, not recovery. | The professionals are simply not taking part.

market-bottom.title: Recognising a market bottom

marks.text: but the market does not fall

market-bottom.note: If the volume at (a) had really been selling, the market could not be higher | a few bars later. So it was buying.

professional-support.title: What professional support looks like

marks.text: closes in the middle on very high volume

professional-support.note: In a downtrend, a high-volume down-bar closing middle or high, | followed by an up-bar, says demand has overcome supply.

stops.title: Where to put a stop
stops.note: Place stops below the last reaction low, not at an arbitrary distance — | and on odd numbers, because the crowd uses round ones.

reading-a-bar.title: What you read on every single bar
reading-a-bar.note: Any one of them on its own will mislead you. They are only meaningful together.
